## `set_project_analyst`

*Available in [R](#set_project_analyst-r), [Python](#set_project_analyst-python)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to set the  project analyst.
    This will overwrite the current value if exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    set_project_analyst(analyst_name)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `analyst_name` - A string containing the analyst name

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A message stating the name has been changed.


=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    None
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    set_project_analyst(
        analyst,
        project=None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `analyst` (`str | list[str] | None`) - None
    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - None

    <h4>Returns `None`</h4>

    *No return value*
